about: Live tests, at most 3 per channel (owner approved Nov 7). Edit with care: `python Tools/lab.py score` closes decided tests and starts the next queued one for that channel. kind 'ab' = two arms of one feature; 'lane' = one group vs every other Short of the channel in the same window. Features are columns of Research Notes/Lab/shorts.csv (detected from the files); a feature no file shows is read from the card's `**Arms:** <test>=A|B` line, which `lab.py assign <ch> --folder F` writes.

live.question: Are record lists a hit lane we can repeat?

how.B: a 'Who has ___ the most in NBA history?' list from Basketball-Reference career leaders, numbered 'Part N'; copy-check it

how.B: open the title with Why, How, What or Who ('Why NBA Players Refuse...'); same length, still searchable
